name: kpstechnology-web
description: KPS Technology website and fleet management application

scripts.build: npm run clean:build && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.clean:build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const dir=path.join(process.cwd(),'build'); if (fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true});"
